Solution 2 is correct. The smallest number of leaves is $103$.

The condition is $2n = 7k + 3$ with $n > 100$. Modulo 7, $2n \equiv 3$, and since $2 \cdot 4 \equiv 1$, multiplying by 4 gives $n \equiv 12 \equiv 5 \pmod 7$. The values just above 100 have residues $101 \equiv 3$, $102 \equiv 4$, $103 \equiv 5$, so $n = 103$ is the first one that works.

Check: $2 \cdot 103 = 206 = 7 \cdot 29 + 3$, and $103 > 100$.

Solution 1 is wrong because it only tries values of $k$ and wrongly concludes $n = 19$, which is not greater than 100. Solution 3 is wrong because $n = 112$ is not the smallest valid value; $n = 103$ is smaller and works.

CHOICE: 2
